sections.heading: Objectives
paragraphs: Take Koss and Melonni to speak with Butoh the Bold to prepare the defenses of the Grand Forum of Vabb. (Koss and Melonni must be equipped heroes) Help defend the Grand Forum of Vabb. If it should fall, so will the Kodash Bazaar. Speak with Butoh the Bold. See Zerai the Learner for your reward.

sections.heading: Reward
paragraphs: 2,500 Experience 250 Gold 10 Lightbringer Points

sections.heading: Walkthrough
paragraphs: Start in The Kodash Bazaar. Head out southwest and walk to Butoh the Bold. After talking to him, five groups of Margonites will spawn one after each other. Don't wait in the center for them to arrive, but head directly toward the first group in the southwest. The Ruby Djinn will help you, therefore it is a good idea to heal them. Proceed with the next groups. Don't worry about Margonites massing in the center, they won't do anything until/unless you're in aggro range. After killing all groups, talk again to Butoh the Bold. Map back to The Kodash Bazaar for your reward.

sections.heading: Allies
paragraphs: Elementals (Djinn)
24 Ruby Djinn

sections.heading: Foes
paragraphs: Demons (Margonites)
24 Margonite Executioner 24 Margonite Bowmaster 24 Margonite Cleric 24 Margonite Warlock 24 Margonite Seer 24 Margonite Ascendant 24 Margonite Reaper

sections.heading: Initial dialogue
paragraphs: Zerai the Learner "Varesh's crusade west through the Desolation has weakened the barrier between our world and the nightmare realm. Already, many suffer terrible nightmares as Abaddon takes advantage of their fears and secrets. It is true. Nightfall is at hand. No doubt they will try to overtake the Grand Forum of Vabb, and with it the Kodash Bazaar. I have been instructed to use the Djinn of Ahdashim to protect key areas. Go with Koss and Melonni to speak with Butoh the Bold. Tell him the djinn will help protect things. He is a great fighter and will know how best to use them in battle. Will you help us one more time, hero?"
Accept: "Without a doubt." Decline: "I'm sure Vabbi is safe." Ask: "Butoh the Bold is in Forum Highlands, just outside the Kodash Bazaar."

sections.heading: Intermediate dialogue
paragraphs: Butoh the Bold "Ah, great heroes indeed. These djinn that Zerai sent will come in handy. I have stationed them at the edges of the forum. I fear an attack will come all too soon. Several merchants suffering from terrible nightmares have already fled. I fear they will serve as conduits for Abaddon's forces. Here they come!"
Whenever a Margonite group spawns Butoh the Bold: "Here they come!"
Butoh the Bold: "Lyssa protect us!"
Butoh the Bold: "They're everywhere!"
Butoh the Bold: "Get behind the Djinn!"

sections.heading: Cinematic
paragraphs: Koss: "Melonni? What's the matter?" Melonni: "Koss! I've had a horrible vision. I saw my village, Ronjok, surrounded by these tendrils and transformed into a nightmare realm." Koss: "Sounds like a bad dream." Melonni: "Not a dream. More like an intrusion. A warning. Like I was in someone else's nightmare." Koss: "Those tendrils are bad, but they seem to have stabilized." <Party leader>: "No, Melonni is right. I have been told the Garden of Seborhin has been transformed by these things. It has fallen into night." Koss: "The garden? We must go there at once." Melonni: "No. If it happened here, it happened in Ronjok as well. We must go there instead." Koss: "Melonni, no! We need to address a real problem, not a silly dream." Melonni: "Not a dream. A vision. My village has risked everything on our behalf. They're more important than a few plants." Koss: "The garden is very important to the princes. We've worked hard to make them our allies." Melonni: "Allies? You just care about wealthy princes instead of ordinary people." Koss: "I care about a real threat, not about some distracting dream!" Melonni: "Not a dream, a vision! You're just being stubborn!" Koss: "You think you're always right!" <Party leader>: "Enough!" Melonni: "You lead our party, and I will abide by your decision. You must choose which way we go." Koss: "Agreed. You lead and I shall follow. Which will it be - the garden or the village?"

sections.heading: Intermediate dialogue
paragraphs: Butoh the Bold "Zerai and Mehtu the Wise have indeed saved the day; as have all of you. It seems you now have to make a choice. Before you do, speak with Zerai. He will see that you are amply rewarded for your courage. I have not seen a fight like that since Ahmtur the Mighty last cleared the halls of Ahdashim. May Lyssa protect us from Nightfall."

sections.heading: Reward dialgoue
paragraphs: Zerai the Learner "Please take this as thanks. I fear this is only the beginning. The Garden of Seborhin has fallen and Ronjok may be in peril. It seems you must now make a choice, hero."

sections.heading: Notes
paragraphs: A paragon with "They're on Fire!" will greatly reduce the damage dealt by the Margonites. If you have the quest Norgu's Nightfall active, Butoh the Bold will not spawn.
Bug.Sometimes even after killing all groups that have spawned you still won't complete the quest. This might be caused by one of the Vabbian Commoners being stuck behind a Vabbian Chest.

The Grand Forum of Vabb of The Kodash Bazaar is under attack! Go and help defend it with the aid of the Djinn.

Quest information[edit]

Requirements[edit]

  • Required heroes: Koss and Melonni.

Objectives[edit]

  • Take Koss and Melonni to speak with Butoh the Bold to prepare the defenses of the Grand Forum of Vabb. (Koss and Melonni must be equipped heroes)
  • Help defend the Grand Forum of Vabb. If it should fall, so will the Kodash Bazaar.
  • Speak with Butoh the Bold.
  • See Zerai the Learner for your reward.

Reward[edit]

  • 2,500 Experience
  • 250 Gold
  • 10 Lightbringer Points

Walkthrough[edit]

Start in The Kodash Bazaar. Head out southwest and walk to Butoh the Bold. After talking to him, five groups of Margonites will spawn one after each other. Don't wait in the center for them to arrive, but head directly toward the first group in the southwest. The Ruby Djinn will help you, therefore it is a good idea to heal them. Proceed with the next groups. Don't worry about Margonites massing in the center, they won't do anything until/unless you're in aggro range. After killing all groups, talk again to Butoh the Bold. Map back to The Kodash Bazaar for your reward.

Will you help us one more time, hero?"

 Decline: "I'm sure Vabbi is safe."
 Ask: "Butoh the Bold is in Forum Highlands, just outside the Kodash Bazaar."
